title: Dutch Chicken Salad
description: A delicious and easy-to-make salad with chicken, kissed by the flavors of the Dutch cuisine. This dish is perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.

ingredients.name: kissed vinegar
ingredients.notes: apple cider vinegar or white wine vinegar

instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and pepper. Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes or until cooked through.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mustard and vinegar until smooth.
Add the salad mix, cherry tomatoes, and cucumber to the bowl. Toss to combine.
Once the chicken is cooked, let it rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly.
Add the sliced chicken to the salad and toss to combine.
